Results.ReviewText: I had a great experience with Weber.  My grill, after 4 years was not lighting on the right side.  Weber sent me the replacement parts and they were easy to install and I'm back to having my "Old Reliable" grill back in action.   Great support from Weber!
Results.Title: Great support from Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Just what I expected + the App has made the purchase satisfying
Results.Title: As Expected + the App.

Results.ReviewText: Weber customer service was helpful in troubleshooting my problem and sending me the appropriate parts swiftly. Parts came with illustrations/instructions on how to replace. Didn't take much time to replace and works great!
Results.Title: Quick Resolution of my Replacement Part Needs

Results.ReviewText: As a couple without children and only occasional houseguests, we wanted the ability to cook for groups sometimes, but primarily for just the two of us. This grill has all of the necessary features without too many bells and whistles (most of which I consider unnecessary anyway). Electric starter, direct and indirect heat, thermometer, propane tank fuel gauge, plenty of space on the shelves, plenty of hanging spots for tools, warming rack, what else do you really need? A great grill for small groups/families.
Results.Title: A perfect fit for small households!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for your feedback! We are sorry to hear about the trouble you are experiencing when installing your tank. We have passed your feedback along to the appropriate team. There is a hole on the bottom of the panel where you can use to help push the tank upwards and hang it on the scale assembly. We want to check if this tip helps! Please be on the lookout for a follow-up email from us shortly. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Tank valve is rather awkward to access & tank heavy to install in the limited space.
Results.Title: Awkward Installation

Results.ReviewText: Even heat with nice solid grates. Aluminum bottom pan should not rust out.
Results.Title: Good value

Results.ReviewText: So far so good. Great grill, seems to have one temp: HIGH! But cooking fast and hot per the recommendation has worked out great with this grill!
Results.Title: Hot and Fast

Results.ReviewText: We are so happy we decided to spend a bit more money and get a Weber grill. We wanted to replace our larger grill with a smaller size and knew of the great reputation Weber Grills have, so once I convinced my husband it would be worth it, we made the purchase. He is the one who does most of the actual grilling and he couldn't be more pleased with how much better the food being cooked turns out. The guide book and suggestions for grill times and methods is excellent too. Keeping it clean has been easy as well ... one of our best purchases to date!! Quality is so worth it!!!
Results.Title: Love our Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this barbecue a month ago and have been very happy with it. I have barbecued chicken, steak, pork chops and vegetables and found the grill kept the desired temperature and heat evenly for an excellent finish.
Results.Title: Excellent barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Nice size for a small family. Having trouble with trying to keep the temperature low. When gas is on and both burners are on the lowest settings the temperature has a tendency to creep up to the 450 - 500 degree range. Have to almost turn off the valve to the propane tank to have it settle around 350.  Nice grill otherwise. Good complement to my smoker.
Results.Title: Nice small grill minor temperature adjustment

Results.ReviewText: I’ve only used it a few times but it’s a great grill so far!
Results.Title: So far, so good!

Results.ReviewText: Well designed and cooks great.  It's the perfect size for a smaller patio.
Results.Title: Happy with this purchase

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your comments and feedback regarding the Spirit E-210. We are sorry to learn about the side tables and the control panel have shown some signs of corrosion. We see that one of our reps is working with you on replacement parts. We have reached out via email to offer some tips on caring for your grill when in a coastal environment. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: An amazing product which is backed by a warranty and customer service that is second to none. The issue is with the quality of the material. Unfortunately, even with a cover the portions which we believed to be stainless steel was rusted within two months of purchase. As stated above, the customer service and warranty provided compensate for the unfortunate/unexpected quality mishap.
Results.Title: Unfortunate quality, yet, great customer service

Results.ReviewText: So far the new grill is Awesome. What a difference from my last grill. Heat over 500 degrees and cooks evenly
Results.Title: Finally bought a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill - I've used it almost every night since I got it 2 months ago! Easy to turn on, consistent heat and even cooking. Fits perfectly on my small patio. Also, the propane gauge is accurate and makes it easy to tell when I'm running low. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is great small and yet big enough for cooking several items at once.
Results.Title: Great Customer service

Results.ReviewText: J’ai acheté mon nouveau b.bq avec ma nouvelle maison. Mon fils m’a recommandé un weber. Je ne connaissais la marque. Je puis vous assurer que j’ai acheté quelque chose de très bien
Results.Title: Cuisson parfaite.

Results.ReviewText: We bought this about two months ago and we always get excellent results, be it pork, chicken, steak, and even roasting duck! My husband is enjoying using his Weber grill this summer, and would definitely still enjoy it during winter. This is the best bbq grill we have ever owned.
Results.Title: Excellent grill over all

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We appreciate your feedback on the Spirit E 210 gas grill. We are very sorry to hear of the issue you had with the casters. We would not expect this to happen with the grill. We have reached out via email to discuss this more in detail with you. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The wheels have stabilizers the touch the ground making it very difficult to roll. One wheel broke off. The company send me new wheels but the screws were stripped and couldn't be removed. Lowe's replaced the grill with a new one, but it has the same problem. I'm afraid to move it and break the wheel again. Cooks good though. What a headache.
Results.Title: Not so great!

Results.ReviewText: I find the controls easy to adjust to the desired temperature.  My only dissapointment is the difficu!ty in lifting the propane tank and securing it on the scale hook.
Results.Title: Only dissapointment.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned the same Weber grill for the last 26 years! It was time to upgrade to new grill, especially another Weber.  This brand seems to outlast others. I've used my Spirit E-210 for 3 months now, I was initially concerned that the grill surface wasn't going to be big enough for my family of six, but it's never a problem. The other thing that I've noticed, it sips propane compared to my old 3-burner.  Just finished my father's 80th birthday party and cooked for 26 people...steaks were perfect and the grill outperformed my expectations.  Thanks Weber, you'll have a happy customer for another 26 years!
Results.Title: Little Black Beast!

Results.ReviewText: Great grille, fairly easy assembly--although the entire propane control assembly attachment was left out of the instructions, this wasn't my first rodeo so I figured it all out! Works great, grilles great, this will be a long term product because Webber makes the best gas grilles out there! Even when parts wear out, spare parts are always available and are of quality to keep your grille running as good as the day you bought it. Highly recommended!! Pete
Results.Title: Webber E-210 Grille-- Best grille & worth it!!

Results.ReviewText: Side tables fold down so can store in smaller area. Great space between the two burners for indirect heating. Grill heats up fast and hot for searing.
Results.Title: Small but mighty.

Results.ReviewText: Very good performing grill.  Seeing a little rusting on the painted areas
Results.Title: Top performance

Results.ReviewText: I just bought this grill because I have had the exact same grill for the last 6 years.  The wheels had been falling apart for the past year and they are not covered by the warranty.  So I gave away my old grill and bought a new one to see if I have better luck.
Results.Title: Good grill..........bad wheels

Results.ReviewText:
Love this grill! Built like a rock. The ONLY complaint is the difficulty lifting the LP tank on to the built in gauge bracket. 
Perfect size for 2 people and my small patio.
Results.Title: Buy it!

Results.ReviewText:
After being gifted with an old Weber gas grill (perhaps 11 - 12 years ago; and rebuilding it along the way) my Genesis 1000 finally moved on to that "great grill haven in the next world" . . . . . 
I replaced it with the Spirit E-210 - and am now enjoying grilling all over again. Comparing it to other brands available (and I work for a large grocery chain that brings a large selection of brands and styles every summer), dollar for dollar, you can't beat a Weber . . . . . .
Results.Title: 2nd Generation Grilling

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect !  It’s easy to use, easy to light, and cooks everything perfectly!!
Results.Title: Lovin my new grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new gas grill. I previously had a Weber gas grill which lasted me 16 years. Couldn’t find replacement parts as that model is discontinued. I swear by Weber grills and enjoy grilling on it.
Results.Title: Best purchase

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your bottom panel rusted! We would be happy to look into this for you. Please be on the lookout for a follow-up email from us shortly. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grilling on the Weber is great, however the cabinet design collects water and has rusted out to the point where the casters have been pushed through the floor of the cabinet.
Results.Title: Good but rusty cabinet

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback on your new Spirit E-210. We see that one of our reps has sent out a new door hinge to fix this issue. The lid handle can get hot during use, or if left in the sun. We always recommend wearing a BBQ mitt when using the grill. Please look out for an email from us discussing this further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this BBQ a month ago and when I assembled it the door was missing the spring loaded hinge that attaches to the body of the grill.Also I find the handle gets very hot while grilling and the response I get back is "use gloves". I never needed gloves with my previous grill!!
Results.Title: Dissatisfied

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Alex, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the trouble with identifying replacement parts for your Spirit E-210. We are here, ready to help, and we apologize for the disappointment you experienced with the delay. We will reach out to help provide additional details on your grill via email. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I emailed the support weeks ago about identifying my exact grill model so I can buy replacement parts. I literally asked them to help me spend more money with them but nothing. No response yet and I don't ever expect to get one at this point. The replacement parts are not divided by which grill you have but by the part you need that every grill has. To compound this issue, my grill seems to have model years which matter for the parts. No model year came with my grill in it's detailed model numbers but since that's how they sell parts I would have thought this would be much easier than it is. I can't recommend this.
Results.Title: Only because you emailed me to ask

Results.ReviewText: It's everything I hope for in a grill. Especially like the tank meter, showing how much propane is in the tank.
Results.Title: Love it!!

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. I use it 2x a week or more. It's the best grill I've owed, and I look forward to using it for years to come!
Results.Title: My first Weber

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality great results great design produces great steaks
Results.Title: Excellent quality

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
